discovery.summary: Greenfield monorepo: Scala + Apache Pekko API (sbt, Pekko Persistence on Postgres) in backend/, TypeScript + React + Vite web app (pnpm) in frontend/, OpenAPI contract between them, Terraform on AWS for the API's infrastructure, backend container image in infra/, GitHub PRs + GitHub Actions, root justfile

commands.install: just install  # sbt update + pnpm install
commands.build: just build  # sbt compile + pnpm build
commands.test: just test  # sbt test + pnpm test
commands.test_single: just test-single <path>  # backend: sbt "testOnly *FooSpec"; frontend: pnpm vitest run <file>
commands.lint: just lint  # sbt scalafmtCheckAll "scalafixAll --check" + pnpm lint
commands.typecheck: just typecheck  # sbt compile + pnpm typecheck (tsc --noEmit)

notable_folders.note: domain core module: every behaviour change needs data-driven (table-driven) tests
persisted Pekko events: evolve with new versions and event adapters, never change or drop a persisted field
plan before apply; the agent never applies; plan output in the PR

existing_gates.branch_protection: none (no default branch yet; main intended)
outside_repo: out of scope (post-merge, user): security sign-off, architecture review, demo before release, CAB

pr.where: GitHub pull requests on origin; base branch main

upstream.where: GitHub epic issue holds the intent and design summaries and the approval; the full intent.md, spec.md and design/*.md are committed in docs/work/<date>-<slug>/ (agent syncs the epic and the files after each round)
upstream.tickets: GitHub sub-issues of the epic; ids kept in tickets.json

phases.purpose: Capture what and why as intent.md

gate.mechanism: 'intent-approved' label or approval comment on the epic by any team member except the work item's driver

phases.exit: Problem, outcome, affected users and systems, constraints and open questions all filled; PO approved

phases.purpose: Turn the accepted intent into spec.md plus the design subphases the work item needs

gate.mechanism: 'design-approved' label or approval comment on the epic by any team member except the work item's driver

phases.exit: EARS acceptance criteria; concerns flagged and resolved; fresh-context review passed

subphases.when: new component or service, crosses deliverables, changes a boundary, or needs an ADR; includes a STRIDE threat model when a change crosses a trust boundary (public API, IAM, data store)
subphases.artifact: design/solution.md + docs/decisions/ ADR + threat model section

subphases.when: changes api/openapi.yaml or the backend's HTTP surface
changes persisted Pekko events, serializers or the journal schema
changes infra/ (Terraform, AWS) or the backend container image; includes a STRIDE threat model for IAM/network changes

phases.purpose: plan.md plus vertical-slice tickets with blocking edges

checks: plan.md has Files / Order / Risks / Proof
every acceptance criterion maps to a ticket with a verify command
fresh-context AI plan review: no blocking findings
gate.escalate_when: the plan touches infra, ci or migrations, or the AI review reports blocking findings

phases.exit: plan.md has Files / Order / Risks / Proof; every ticket fits one context window and lists its blockers

phases.purpose: Build-validate: implement each ticket locally, test-first, and validate it before anything is shared
phases.artifact: local branch with validation evidence in progress.md

validate.tests: red-green: each acceptance criterion gets a failing test first

gate.escalate_when: validation still fails after 3 attempts, or an existing test had to change

phases.exit: Every acceptance criterion of the ticket has a passing test; validate checks green; evidence in progress.md; nothing pushed for review yet

phases.purpose: Open the PR, run the automated and AI reviews its tier calls for, resolve findings, get human approval
phases.artifact: pull request with evidence, tier label and resolved findings

gate.mechanism: approvals per PR tier (review.pr.tiers) through branch protection or rulesets; conversation resolution; the authoring agent can't approve; this approval is the deploy gate: merge to main triggers deploys

phases.exit: Checks green; AI and lens findings resolved or dismissed with a reason; approvals meet the PR's tier

phases.purpose: Merge to main triggers CD: deploy everything (Terraform apply, image push, API and web deploy) behind flags, with health checks and rollback

checks: merged to main through an approved PR
gate.escalate_when: a health check fails or the release touches a critical-tier path

phases.exit: Deployed; health checks green; rollback path verified
phases.basis: propose.py; https://claude.com/resources/articles/the-ai-native-sdlc-playbook; outside approvals (security, architecture, demo, CAB) happen post-merge and are out of scope (user)

phases.purpose: Turn signals, incidents and session lessons into new intents and evidence-backed harness changes

checks: product findings become intents (they pass the intent gate)
harness changes ship as PRs (they pass the review phase gate)
eval suite passes before and after a harness change

phases.exit: Every finding is an intent, a harness PR, or a recorded no-op; evals pass after harness changes
triggers: after a model or tool upgrade
phases.research: researcher subagent checks root causes and current practice against primary sources before a harness change; notes in docs/sdlc/research/
phases.evals: review.evals suite 'harness' (run-evals.sh --suite harness, before on the base and after on the branch)

afk_allowed_for: all ready-for-agent tickets with executable acceptance criteria: build-validate and review, up to merge to main

afk.done: every acceptance criterion's verify command passes
afk.self_check: just typecheck, just test, diff-guard.sh, the ticket's verify command; Playwright screenshot diffs for web tickets
afk.may_touch: any path in the repo, including infra/ and .github/workflows/ (nothing deploys before merge); blocked: push or merge to main, force push, terraform apply, reading or printing secrets; append-only rules for applied migrations and persisted events still apply
afk.stops: 120 turns, 3 failed validations, $25 budget, or completion promise
afk.result: agent-opened PR; its human approval (any team member except the driver) is the deploy gate

design.method: decisions surface during solution design; MADR
infra subphase: AWS Well-Architected checklist, SLOs, least-privilege IAM, cost, STRIDE threat model for IAM/network

deliverables.test: terraform fmt -check, validate, tflint, checkov, terraform test
deliverables.review: critical tier; plan output attached to the PR
deliverables.ship: terraform apply from GitHub Actions on merge to main via AWS OIDC role; the agent never applies

design.method: pipeline changes designed in solution when needed

deliverables.build: GitHub Actions; actions pinned by SHA; minimal permissions

design.method: data subphase: event versioning, event adapters, invariants, expand-contract

deliverables.test: golden fixtures of every past event version must deserialize; journal replay against Testcontainers Postgres
deliverables.review: critical tier + data-integrity and migration-compat lenses
deliverables.ship: expand -> migrate -> contract; never drop or change a persisted field

design.method: api subphase: contract-first, error model, compatibility classification, examples -> contract tests

deliverables.review: critical tier; breaking change needs an ADR and a version bump
deliverables.ship: merge = published; frontend client regenerated (just gen-client)

deliverables.test: ScalaTest table-driven tests (required in backend/core/), ScalaCheck properties, ActorTestKit, Testcontainers Postgres integration, contract test against api/openapi.yaml
deliverables.ship: CD on merge to main, behind feature flags; rehearsed rollback

deliverables.build: multi-stage Dockerfile, Temurin JRE base pinned by digest, non-root
deliverables.ship: pushed to ECR and deployed by CD on merge to main

design.method: ux subphase: every screen state, WCAG 2.2 AA

deliverables.test: testing trophy: Vitest + Testing Library, Playwright E2E with toHaveScreenshot, axe (WCAG 2.2 AA)
deliverables.review: screenshots in the PR + persona lenses + 1 approval
deliverables.ship: CD on merge to main (S3 + CloudFront), behind feature flags

deliverables.build: Diataxis runbooks: deploy, rollback, one per alert, incident, on-call
deliverables.test: link check; runbook commands dry-run where possible
deliverables.ship: updated in the same PR as the infra/API change (doc-code drift check)

deliverables.build: Diataxis: business processes, support playbooks, admin procedures
intent, spec, status; release notes from Conventional Commits
deliverables.review: part of the gates they record

AI findings resolved in spec.md 'Review log' and one summary comment on the epic; human approval on the epic
artifacts.blocking: human gate on the epic; AI review is advisory

artifacts.blocking: automated gate: AI review must report no blocking findings; escalates to the team for high-risk plans

reviewers.how: typecheck, tests, diff-guard, ticket verify command

artifacts.blocking: automated build gate; no AI or human review by default

reviewers.how: scripts/sdlc/pr-checks.sh (check-loop, protected paths, diff-guard, tier label) run by /charmander-review

reviewers.when: right after the PR is opened, per tier

artifacts.record: lens findings in reviews/ ledger and one summary comment on the PR; resolved threads
artifacts.blocking: approvals per PR tier via branch protection/rulesets; this approval is the deploy gate (merge to main deploys); AI reviewers never approve or block

reviewers.how: CD pipeline on merge to main: health checks, rollback

artifacts.blocking: none beyond the approved PR; outside approvals are post-merge and out of scope

artifacts.record: harness PR with before/after eval results
artifacts.blocking: review phase gate (approvals per PR tier)

pr.title: imperative summary
pr.body: PR template + evidence (verify output, screenshots) + tier and why
pr.tiering: scripts/sdlc/pr-tier.sh computes the tier; /<prefix>-review labels the PR; pr-checks.sh verifies the label

tiers.why: merge to main deploys infra, CI, persisted events, journal schema, public contract and auth
docs-only changes; harness docs stay standard

evals.on_fail: major finding on the PR: fix and re-run, or a human accepts the regression with a reason
evals.rediscover: check-loop.sh runs detect-evals.sh and fails when a suite in the repo isn't listed here

noise_controls.report: correctness, security, spec gaps; skip style the tools enforce

review.ai_comment_policy: AI reviewers comment, never approve; findings carry severity and evidence; one summary comment updated in place
review.new_reviewer_rollout: shadow mode: post to a log or draft for two weeks, then promote

personas.context: context-less: fresh subagent per lens, only the review point's inputs + the lens file, no CLAUDE.md, never the conversation

install.name: mattpocock-skills
install.how: npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills -a cursor -a codex

install.name: typescript-lsp, context7, playwright, github, terraform, security-guidance

global.standard: run everything through the root justfile (just test, just test-single, just lint, ...)
Scala 3 LTS; scalafmt + scalafix; -Werror; no null/var/return; never block inside actors or streams
global.enforced_by: pre-commit + Stop check (just lint, just typecheck); scoped rule

global.standard: strict tsconfig, no any; ESLint flat config + Prettier; tsc --noEmit

ci-cd.standard: pin actions by SHA; minimal permissions; no pull_request_target with PR checkout

api-contract.standard: OpenAPI 3.1; breaking change needs ADR + version

api-image.standard: multi-stage, base pinned by digest, non-root

scoped.name: backend
scoped.rule: Scala 3 + Pekko typed actors. Never block inside actors or streams. Run just test-single <spec> while iterating.

scoped.name: core-data-driven-tests
scoped.rule: Domain core. Every behaviour change ships a table-driven ScalaTest (TableDrivenPropertyChecks) covering the cases.
scoped.enforced_by: pr-checks.sh fails when backend/core/src/main changes without backend/core/src/test; test-quality lens

scoped.name: persisted-events
scoped.rule: Persisted events are forever: add a new event version and an event adapter; never change or remove a persisted field; never edit existing golden fixtures.
scoped.enforced_by: protect-paths hook on existing fixtures; golden fixture test

scoped.name: journal-migrations
scoped.rule: Append-only. Never edit an applied journal script; add a new one.
scoped.enforced_by: protect-paths hook blocks edits to existing files

scoped.name: api-contract
scoped.rule: Contract-first: change the contract before the code. Breaking changes need an ADR and a version bump.

scoped.name: frontend
scoped.rule: TypeScript strict, no any. Import the API only through the generated client.

scoped.name: generated-client
scoped.rule: Generated. Regenerate with just gen-client; never hand-edit.

scoped.name: infra
scoped.rule: Plan, never apply. Attach terraform plan output to the PR.
scoped.enforced_by: permissions deny terraform apply; tflint + checkov

scoped.name: workflows
scoped.rule: Pin actions by SHA; least-privilege permissions.

scoped.name: secrets
scoped.rule: Never read, print or commit (.env.example is fine).

scoped.name: decisions
scoped.enforced_by: protect-paths hook on accepted ADRs; review

context.code_graph: typescript-lsp + Metals MCP + docs/sdlc/REPO_MAP.md (repo-map.sh); no semantic graph

guardrails.failure_mode: Agent skips, deletes or weakens tests to go green
guardrails.mitigation: Block skipped/deleted tests and net assertion loss unless a human approves (ScalaTest ignore/pending, Vitest .skip/.only)
guardrails.enforced_by: diff-guard.sh in the Stop hook, the pre-commit hook and pr-checks.sh

guardrails.mitigation: Exit criteria per phase; Stop hook runs typecheck + tests; validation evidence required before the PR
plan.md names files; one ticket per session; warn above 400 changed lines / 30 files

guardrails.failure_mode: Reviewer floods the PR with nits; real issues get lost
guardrails.mitigation: Cap nits at 5; review for correctness and spec gaps only; skip what linters enforce
guardrails.enforced_by: REVIEW.md + reviewer prompt + dedupe-findings.py; one summary comment updated in place

guardrails.failure_mode: Authoring agent (or a lenient evaluator) approves its own work
guardrails.mitigation: Fresh-context reviewer; AI never approves; approver is a team member other than the driver, via branch protection/rulesets
guardrails.enforced_by: branch protection or rulesets; validator requires a human gate on the review phase and a human approval in every PR tier

guardrails.mitigation: New dependencies must exist in their registry; typecheck catches fake APIs

guardrails.failure_mode: Unbounded loops and cost in unattended runs
guardrails.mitigation: 120 turns, $25 budget, 3 failed validations; Stop-hook block cap 3
Block reads of .env (not .env.example); secret scanning (forge setting or the existing CI)

guardrails.failure_mode: A persisted Pekko event changes shape and old journals no longer replay
guardrails.mitigation: Golden fixtures for every past event version; append-only serialization folder
guardrails.enforced_by: golden fixture test in just test; protect-paths hook

guardrails.failure_mode: Swallowed Future failures, empty catches, missing actor supervision hide failures
guardrails.mitigation: No swallowed failures; explicit supervision; validate only at boundaries

guardrails.failure_mode: Ops manuals go stale when infra or API changes
guardrails.mitigation: Infra/API change must touch docs/ops/tech/ in the same PR

guardrails.failure_mode: Lockfile changes without a manifest change

guardrails.mitigation: Max 3 review rounds, then escalate to a human
Root AGENTS.md <= 200 lines; scoped rules and nested AGENTS.md

tracker.details: GitHub Issues via gh CLI against origin; epics as parent issues, tickets as sub-issues

enforcement.git_hooks: the existing hook manager, else plain .githooks (no new dependency)

existing_ci.note: read only: the loop never edits existing CI

ci.why: the loop's checks run locally; CI changes only when the user asks
